in_sanskrit.name: Naira
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Naira एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: Naira
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar
in_hindi.long_meaning: Naira एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: Naira
in_tamil.long_meaning: Naira ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: Naira
in_telugu.long_meaning: Naira ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Naira
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Naira
in_bengali.long_meaning: Naira একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niraj', meaning 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, nectar is a drink believed to bestow immortality and prosperity.
